items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: we found that Lilly St. Clair was playing on the bill

ctx.x: Yeah, he booked us there, but he wasn't working in the act. So he booked us up there to work on his program. He didn't give no publicity for the man to give us any billing so we found that Lilly St. Clair was playing on the bill and couldn't find our name out there nowhere. Finally he told us the manager didn't send no publicity on us, so he couldn't put nothing out. So we told him what we could and we worked two weeks up there and we were coming back to New York.
Who were you working with up there?
